versions.content: If the Dem module is requested to clear diagnostic in- formation and the configuration parameter DemClearDTCBehavior is set to DEM_CLRRESP_NONVOLATILE_FINISH , the Dem module shall return DEM_CLEAR_MEMORY_ERROR if the clearing of the non-volatile memory fails.
